paragraphs: Payment Service Network, also called PSN, sells electronic bill presentment and payment services to business industries including utility, municipal and government, property management, funeral services, insurance, and financial. Customers can initiate payments online, by call-in, text, counter, cash payment location, bank bill payment system, credit card, eCheck, eSavings, paper check, cash or money order. PSN states that all payments are consolidated for one deposit, one posting to your software, and one reconciliation report.

The company was established in 1999, and its stated aim was to automate the recurring customer payment process by integrating the SaaS PSN system with account management software. As a result, PSN serves over 1,000 business accounts, and in 2020 it joined forces with InvoiceCloud.

PSN performs all work in-house, with security and customer service named as the highest priorities. A client has a Service Account Manager who provides training and support. Integration to the PSN platform is set up through a batch process, real-time data interchange, or a tokenization exchange.
